outcome: Finnegan scores (severity of Neonatal Abstinence Syndrome)
cohort: Australian infants exposed to opiates in utero between 2004 and 2007.
finding: Preterm infants exposed to opiates in utero had significantly lower maximum Finnegan scores, were less likely to be medicated for NAS, and received lower median morphine doses compared to term infants.
gest_age: Preterm infants: mean 34 (SD 3) weeks (<37 weeks gestation); Term infants: mean 38 (SD 3) weeks.
